periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique vertical orientation, approximately 70 to 80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High aspect ratio characterized by an elongated, teardrop-shaped oval.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering where the patch narrows significantly toward the inferior pole.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant thickness, occupying approximately 35-40% of the visible vertical torso height from the shoulder down.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, estimated at 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semi-circular convex curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced rufous or brownish discoloration of the pelage in the lower abdominal and pelvic region.
